title: Import lexicon from a csv file — import_lexicon_csv
text: file must least following columns: entry: lexical entry, appear head entry. gloss: gloss entry. Optionally, file can following columns: definition: full definition entry. normally provides details meaning gloss. column present, definition field filled gloss. phon: phonetic transcription entry. morph_category: category entry (e.g. lexical vs grammatical). morph_type: type morpheme (e.g. root vs affix). part_of_speech: part speech entry. class: lexical class entry (e.g. verbal conjugations, noun classes). etymology: etymology entry. notes: free text notes. Note list temporary change future.

title: lexaR 0.0.3.9000
text: Now “texts” sentences “collections”. means folder texts now called collections yaml file name cl_00000n.yaml. lexa database schema now developed https://github.com/lexa-tools/lexa-schema. longer supporting Rmarkdown. Please use Quarto interlinear package.

title: lexaR 0.0.3.9000
text: write_merged_lexicon() write single yaml file lexicon entries. open_entry() open entry YAML file. Use edit_entry() wish edit entry want date_modified field automatically updated current date. edit_entry() open entry YAML file update date_modified current date. import_lexicon_lift() import LIFT lexicon Lexa (experimental). Added multilingual support lexicon entries. (closes #4)

title: lexaR 0.0.3.9000
text: add_entry() now checks homophones exist. specification lexical entry now homophone field (numeric). search_lexicon() new argument show_entry , TRUE, prints entry info (’s FALSE default). whole argument search_lexicon() now FALSE default. load_lexadb() now checks validity lexical entries based expected schema.
